notes: Fixes the actual cause of Settle Up via UPI being declined with "exceeded bank limit" even for ₹1-2 - the payment amount could get sent with a comma instead of a period (e.g. 1,00 instead of 1.00) depending on the phone's language/region settings, which GPay/PhonePe can't parse as a valid amount. Now always sends it the same way regardless of phone settings.
